rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a permanent mark left on the skin.

example.english: They still have a scar on their arm.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zek3 sau2 bei3 zung6 jau5 tiu4 baa1

rows.note: Use this for a lasting psychological effect or trauma rather than a physical mark.

example.english: That accident left them with a psychological scar.
example.traditional: 嗰次意外令佢一直有心理陰影。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 ji3 ngoi6 ling6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 jau5 sam1 lei5 jam1 jing2
